ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What would be most affected if the clams all died?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description first: The diagram is an octopus food web. Near the lower center, there is an organism labeled “Clams.” A blue arrow starts at the clams and points upward toward the central octopus labeled “Octopus Food Web.” Reasoning: In a food web, arrows show food or energy moving from prey to the consumer. Since the arrow from clams goes to the octopus, the octopus depends on clams as food. If all the clams died, the octopus would be most directly affected.
